name: Product Count Down for WooCommerce
author: LogicRays Technologies

sections.description:
This plugin adds a “LR Count Down Settings” section to the admin panel for the plugin settings. You can see the countdown in the header of the product page. Before that, you need to select the checkbox from the product page in the admin panel and set the from and to dates for the countdown.

Steps to enable the countdown:

  • Log in to WordPress
  • Open Products
  • Edit your product
  • Open the Product CountDown tab on the product edit screen
  • The countdown appears on the front end of the product page

The main goal of the plugin is to add a countdown on the product detail page so visitors can register by email to receive a coupon code.

For more features, contact us at Logicrays.
sections.installation:
Important: You must install and activate WooCommerce before using this plugin.

  1. Unzip the downloaded zip file.
  2. Upload the plugin folder into the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress site.
  3. Activate Product Count Down for WooCommerce from the Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

How do I enable the countdown timer on a specific product?

Go to your WooCommerce Products menu, edit the desired product, click the ‘Product CountDown’ tab on the product edit screen, check ‘Enable’, select the ‘From’ and ‘To’ dates/times, and save/update the product.

Where do the coupons sent to customers come from?

The plugin sends standard WooCommerce coupons. First, create a coupon in your WordPress dashboard under Marketing > Coupons. Then, select this coupon in LR Count Down Settings to link it to the email capture form.

What happens when the countdown timer reaches zero?

To keep your sale promotions authentic, the countdown bar and coupon signup popup will automatically hide on the product page as soon as the timer expires.

Can I customize the countdown colors and email template?

Yes, navigate to LR Count Down Settings in your admin menu. From there, you can customize the countdown background color, button text, email form heading/description, email subject, and the actual HTML email template using template tags like {couponName} and {coupon_name}.
